title: Applicable laws.
bodyText: A sponsored captive insurance company shall be subject to this part and to part I. If there is any conflict between this part and part I, this part shall control.
bodyHtml: §431:19-308  Applicable laws.  A sponsored captive insurance company shall be subject to this part and to part I.  If there is any conflict between this part and part I, this part shall control. [L 2008, c 190, pt of §1; am L 2012, c 253, §21]
